arguments.where_clause: CAST(strftime('%H', transactions.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 4
arguments.explanation: Flags transactions whose time of day falls from 01:00 up to and including 04:59, on any date in the data.
assumptions: Night is the window you gave: 01:00:00 through 04:59:59, matched on the hour part of transactions.date (hours 1 to 4).
The rule applies to all transactions regardless of card type, transaction type, or amount.
